tax.text: Proposed rolling back parts of the 2017 tax law to raise revenue for teacher tax credits and special-education funding.
tax.quote: By rolling that exemption back to pre-2017 levels, more than $16 billion could be generated annually by 2028

wages.text: As mayor, he led efforts to raise the minimum wage and proposed increasing teacher compensation through a federal tax credit.
wages.quote: Sam also led efforts to raise the minimum wage

trade.text: He supported reducing tariffs and trade barriers through the Trans-Pacific Partnership, while allowing targeted restrictions for specific goals.
trade.quote: The TPP committed us to reduce tariffs and other trade barriers

debt.text: Liccardo proposes shoring up Social Security and Medicare by lifting the payroll-tax wage cap on high earners rather than cutting benefits.
debt.quote: lifting the inequitable wage cap on payroll taxes that exempts very high earners from paying payroll tax on every dollar in the way that middle-income earners must pay

housing.text: He authored and supported bipartisan legislation designed to streamline development and expand the housing supply.
housing.quote: bipartisan legislation to expand housing supply

schools.text: He proposed increasing federal support for public schools, including fully funding the federal special-education commitment and expanding tutoring.

safety.text: As mayor, he increased police staffing while also developing mental-health-professional responses for unhoused people.
safety.quote: He rebuilt the San Jose Police Department, adding more than 200 officers, expanding the corps of civilian service officers to respond to community concerns, and pioneered response to unhoused persons with mental health professionals.

immigration.text: He opposed unlawful immigration enforcement and introduced legislation to help highly skilled immigrants educated in the United States remain in the country.
immigration.quote: Introduced the bipartisan Keep Innovators in America Act to help retain highly skilled international talent educated in the United States.

abortion.text: He proposed federal protections against state restrictions on abortion before fetal viability and supported federal funding and access for reproductive care.
abortion.quote: Congress must prohibit states from restricting abortion procedures or drugs

health.text: He supported expanding Medicaid coverage to people nearing release from incarceration and making federal funding available for reproductive health care.
health.quote: Congress must pass the Medicaid Reentry Act—or something like it—immediately.

energy.text: As mayor, he launched a city energy utility that provides electricity described as 95% greenhouse-gas-free.
energy.quote: San José Clean Energy, which today provides San Jose's 1 million residents with 95% GHG-free electricity.

schools.text: He wants federal policies protecting parental rights and letting parents send their children to the school of their choice.
schools.quote: Enact Federal policies to protect parental rights and enable parents to send their children to their school of choice.

safety.text: Says existing criminal laws should be enforced to improve neighborhood security.
safety.quote: Public Safety and Security--People need to feel safe in their neighborhoods. Current laws need to be enforced.

immigration.text: He supports withholding federal money from sanctuary cities to force cooperation with deportations of people in the country illegally who have committed crimes.
immigration.quote: Withholding Federal dollars going to cities who enforce sanctuary city policies that prevent the deportation of criminals who are here illegally.

guns.text: He says he would oppose local policies that limit Second Amendment rights.
guns.quote: Opposing local policies that limit our Second Amendment Rights

energy.text: He wants to make energy cheaper by removing restrictions on oil drilling and building refineries in California.
energy.quote: Make energy more affordable by removing restrictions on drilling for oil and building refineries in California.
